alternative_explanations: Any apparent gain may be generic prototype smoothing rather than iterative error correction.
confounds: Random byte relabeling, corpus mixture and confidence-based reveal order can interact with sparse prototypes independently of the proposed mechanism.
falsification_criteria: Discard the exact configuration if at rounds 4 and 6 any K cell misses either 0.05 bits-per-byte margin over either source-identical ablation or the 0.02 exact-span-accuracy margin over either ablation.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus mismatch or overlap with the EXP-0044 corpus.
Invalidate if a public query exposes a path, target byte, uncorrupted span or future refinement snapshot.
Invalidate if predictions within one round observe another prediction from that same round.
Invalidate if candidate critical-path work is sequentially hidden inside a declared simultaneous step.

Invalidate if the three predictive-code roles differ in patch geometry, latent width, sparsity, initialization, training order or decoder beyond the preregistered iteration and code-learning interventions.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, seed leakage, byte-permutation leakage or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: End this exact sparse-code configuration without tuning if its preregistered paired margins fail.
outcome_policy.null: The one-seed quick is inconclusive only if failures or uncertainty prevent the preregistered paired contrasts; do not tune constants.
outcome_policy.positive: The exact frozen sparse-code mechanism is worth unchanged multi-seed adversarial replication; no broader architecture claim is permitted.

predicted_outcome: At rounds 4 and 6, in every K cell, the learned iterative role improves mean and worst-span bits per byte by at least 0.05 and exact-span accuracy by at least 0.02 over each source-identical ablation, with finite bounded state and bounded per-round critical depth.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; a positive one-seed scout only authorizes an unchanged three-seed new-corpus adversarial screen, and only if the learned role is implementably Pareto-nondominated after all frozen costs.
research_question: Does a locally learned sparse categorical reconstruction code gain useful masked-span recovery from repeated simultaneous refinement beyond source-identical one-pass and frozen-code ablations at full cost?
title: Locally learned sparse predictive code quick
